direction: Still of the rear wing of the farmhouse seen from the yard: older rubble masonry, a low doorway, a glimpse of a flagstone floor inside. No one is shown finding anything and no object is shown. Slow push toward the doorway. Ambience: dripping gutter. About 12 seconds.

still.prompt: photoreal 16:9 still, rear wing of an old Welsh stone farmhouse c.1880, rough rubble masonry, a low timber doorway standing ajar, worn flagstone floor visible inside in half-light, damp yard cobbles, overcast, no people, no objects, no text, no heraldry

captions.text: c.1880: 'Armour' is reported found under the floor of the rear wing of Great House. It is thought to be the medieval ironwork from Llandough now at the National Museum.
